name: Prometheus Island
description: Prometheus Island was grown, not built: its ridges and gorges come from a single Turing reaction-diffusion seed, and a spring at the summit feeds the stream that cuts through them. At its heart a jukebox keeps the island song, and twelve herb beds ring the garden on the circle of fifths, so a major triad heals, a fifth shields and a tritone poisons. The livestock wear coats grown from the same equations, and each one sings its genome as a call.

attributes.value: spring -> 40-segment stream -> 6 cisterns -> 16 pipes -> 12 troughs; 12 rain catchers; 10-part solar still
12 beds on the circle of fifths, 108 herb meshes; triad=heal, fifth=shield, triplet=speed, tritone=poison
